cues.en: There is no new material or analysis methods in this video.
cues.zh: 這部影片沒有新教材或分析方法。

cues.en: Instead, I just want to make you aware of an area of research in the NLP literature.
cues.zh: 只是想讓你知道，NLP 文獻中的一個研究領域。

cues.en: So one of the questions that I have been posing throughout this section is whether there is some kind
cues.zh: 本節一直提出的一個問題，是是否存在某種

cues.en: of universal space in which language is embedded, and whether different embeddings matrices just represent
cues.zh: 嵌入語言的通用空間，而不同嵌入矩陣，只是使用不同座標系統，

cues.en: this same universal space using different coordinate systems.
cues.zh: 表示同一個通用空間。

cues.en: Now, in this section you explored a few different approaches for addressing this question.
cues.zh: 本節中，你探索了幾種不同方式，來處理這個問題。

cues.en: But this is actually a fairly deep question that other people have spent a lot of time thinking about and investigating.
cues.zh: 但這其實是相當深入的問題，其他人已經花很多時間思考與研究。

cues.en: One way of addressing this question is by trying to translate between embeddings spaces.
cues.zh: 其中一種方式，是試著在嵌入空間之間轉換。

cues.en: Now, you've already seen that the embeddings for the same words are uncorrelated across different embedding spaces.
cues.zh: 你已經看到，相同單字在不同嵌入空間中的嵌入不相關。

cues.en: For example word two vec versus GPT two.
cues.zh: 例如 Word2vec 與 GPT-2。

cues.en: But that doesn't mean that the vectors cannot be directly mapped onto each other.
cues.zh: 但這不表示，向量無法直接映射到彼此。

cues.en: Maybe we just need to find the right rotation and scaling, and then we could actually get from one embeddings to another.
cues.zh: 也許只要找出適當的旋轉與縮放，就能從一種嵌入轉成另一種。

cues.en: So imagine that there is some kind of theoretical abstracted platonic space in which language really
cues.zh: 想像存在某種理論、抽象的柏拉圖式空間，語言真的

cues.en: is encoded as vectors in some high dimensional space.
cues.zh: 在某個高維空間中，被編碼成向量。

cues.en: And any given embedding space like word two, vec or glove or Bert or GPT is just going to be one projection
cues.zh: 任何特定嵌入空間，例如 Word2vec、GloVe、BERT 或 GPT，只是

cues.en: of this fundamental and universal platonic space.
cues.zh: 這個根本、通用的柏拉圖式空間的一種投影。

cues.en: If that is true, then it should be possible to find a way to get from one representation or one projection to another.
cues.zh: 如果如此，應該就能找到方式，從一種表徵或投影，轉到另一種。

cues.en: You can think of it like this.
cues.zh: 可以這樣想。

cues.en: Different embeddings vectors seem different from each other, but it's just a matter of finding the right function that maps these spaces onto each other.
cues.zh: 不同嵌入向量看起來彼此不同，但只是要找到正確函數，把這些空間映射到彼此。

cues.en: I will be honest with you, I kind of doubt that this is really possible.
cues.zh: 老實說，我有點懷疑，這是否真的可能。

cues.en: Language evolves over time, and how we use different words evolves over time.
cues.zh: 語言會隨時間演化，而我們使用不同單字的方式，也會隨時間演化。

cues.en: Furthermore, static word embeddings on their own are actually not very useful for generating new text.
cues.zh: 另外，靜態單字嵌入本身，其實對生成新文字不太有用。

cues.en: Quite the opposite actually.
cues.zh: 事實上，恰恰相反。

cues.en: The only way to get a language model to produce text that is even remotely humanlike is to allow the
cues.zh: 要讓語言模型產生稍微像人類的文字，唯一方式，是允許

cues.en: models to move around the embeddings vectors dynamically, partly based on unique context, with limitless
cues.zh: 模型動態移動嵌入向量，部分根據獨特的上下文，帶來無限

cues.en: possibilities, and partly based on using randomness to guide the token selection.
cues.zh: 可能性，部分則使用隨機性，引導 token 選擇。

cues.en: But I also want to be clear that is just my opinion and other people disagree with me.
cues.zh: 但也想說清楚，這只是我的意見，其他人不同意。

cues.en: I could be wrong.
cues.zh: 我可能是錯的。

cues.en: Anyway, what I want to do here is show a few relevant papers in case you would like to read more into this research area.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡想展示幾篇相關論文，供你想深入閱讀這個研究領域時參考。

cues.en: And also, let me be clear that I think this kind of research is interesting and worth pursuing.
cues.zh: 也說清楚，我認為這類研究很有意思，值得繼續探索。

cues.en: We would not have modern successful without the research and mathematics that has gone into studying token embeddings.
cues.zh: 如果沒有研究 token 嵌入所累積的研究與數學，我們就不會有現代這些成功的成果。
